headline: Moved the 2026-2027 Diwali holiday to November 10 and designated Dr. Joe Clark to sign contracts.
summary: The meeting covered the Ends Policy draft, monitoring reports on staff and student treatment, and a revised financial policy. It approved the Diwali date change, contract signing authority, and the consent agenda, including bills over $50K and staff hires.
decisions: Continued Executive Limitations Policy 2.4 on financial condition and activities to the next meeting as a first reading.
Approved changing the Diwali holiday on the 2026-2027 academic calendar from November 11 to November 10.
Approved designating Dr. Joe Clark and his designees as contracting authorities under 16 V.S.A. § 563(16). The vote was all in favor.
Approved designating a school board member to serve on the Act 170 merger committee. Seamus Abshere said he would be willing to serve.
Approved authorizing the chair to sign the VSBA Superintendent Evaluation contract for the coming school year, at a cost of $2,500.
Approved a motion to review the rubric for Monitoring Report 2.2, Treatment of Staff.
Approved a motion to review the rubric for Monitoring Report 2.1, Treatment of Students and Parents/Guardians.
Approved the consent agenda, including the July 8, 2026 minutes, account payables over $50K, payroll warrants, and one-year staff hires.
Agreed to correct the July 8, 2026 minutes to show that Tom Chittenden did not join the board at the table at that meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: The board reviewed Executive Limitations Policy 2.4 and it will be brought back to the next meeting as a first reading after review by the Chair Abshere.
The board agreed to change the celebration of Diwali on the 2026-2027 Approved Academic Calendar from November 11th to November 10th.

Seamus Abshere called for a motion to Designate Dr. Joe Clark and his designees as Contracting Authorities Pursuant to 16 V.S.A. § 563(16). Michelle Boyer moves, Emilee Hoffman seconds. No discussion. All in favor and motion passes.
Seamus Abshere said he would be willing to serve on the Act 170 merger committee on behalf of the board... Emilee Hoffman moves, Dan Boyer seconds. No discussion. All in favor and the motion passes.

Seamus Abshere called for a motion to authorize the chair to sign the VSBA Superintendent's Evaluation contract for the coming school year. Dan Boyer moves and Michelle Boyer seconds. No discussion. All in favor and motion passes.
Seamus Abshere called for a motion to review the rubric for Monitoring Report 2.2 – Treatment of Staff. Dan Boyer moves and Michelle seconds. No discussion. All in favor and motion passes.

Seamus Abshere called for a motion to review the rubric for Monitoring Report 2.1 Treatment of Students and Parents/Guardians. Dan Boyer moves and Emilee Hoffman seconds. No discussion. All in favor and motion passes.
Items approved included: ... Emilee Hoffman moves, Tom Chittenden seconds. No discussion and motion passes.

Tom Chittenden asked for a correction to the July 8 school board minutes to reflect that he did not join the board at the table at the July 8 meeting as he was not sworn in as a board member yet. The correction will be made to the minutes.
